text: Laws tab at 960x540 shows only Taxes, Conscription, Borders. The fourth law, Rationing, is never drawn (LawsPanel breaks out of the row loop when a block would not fit) although there is visible empty space below Borders and no scroll. A leader at this resolution cannot see or enact Rationing. tick 1631

Bought a member of Oldwood (Hank Thomas) from Stranger to Loyal in ~10 s of game time by pressing G 16 times (10 coins each, 160 coins of a 375 start), then R: he defected to Smallton. Coin gifts have no cooldown, unlike talking (30 s cooldown, +2). Loyalty and defection feel trivially cheap. ticks 5500-5799

With Hank Thomas as Smallton's only other member, neither the Nations tab, the Laws tab nor the HUD names an heir or says what happens if I die. The heir is only revealed by the SuccessionScreen after death. A ruler cannot plan a succession. tick ~6000

After succession (--stage-succession) I now rule as Xavier Lewis, but the HUD (Player Info: Nation, Role, Land) and the Nations tab never show the ruler's name or reign; once the red toast fades, nothing on screen says who I am. tick ~60
